purpose: Complete, byte-lossless, auditable capture of high-frequency guard events within bounded resources; no source algorithm or decision changes.
nonnegotiable_semantics: Every logical event survives with original order, sequence and every field/type/value. No sampling, filtering, aggregation into a statistic or event reordering.
Preserve original v1 canonical JSONL bytes initially, including explicit nonfinite encodings, field ordering and full available RNG data. Compression changes storage only.
No guard/planner re-evaluation, callback decision data, RNG draws/reseeding, live-array views, extra candidate sorting or business-object mutation.
No causal area-loss inference from record/event counts. Original prefix is incomplete and cannot be made valid by re-encoding.

format_candidate.logical_layer: Unchanged ordered v1 logical events. Sequence remains per logical event, never per block.
format_candidate.physical_layer: Single-owner synchronous lossless compressed blocks, initially zlib level1 as a low-CPU candidate; level6 is an offline alternative only. No background compression threads in initial design.
format_candidate.record_boundaries: Flush before next event would exceed target; a record larger than target but within8MiB occupies a dedicated block. No cut/truncation of an event. Larger event invalidates capture; no silent fallback/drop.
format_candidate.index: Append-only block receipts; streaming chain/digest and O(1) retained index state rather than an unbounded in-memory event list.
format_candidate.publication: Write block payload/header to unique pending files, check hashes/counts, flush/fsync/close; publish no-replace links and a block commit receipt last. A visible file alone is not a committed block. Partial pairs or receipts remain incomplete and invalidate whole-run acceptance.
format_candidate.logical_digest: Maintain/reconstruct exact original semantic line-chain and decoded stream SHA. B/C compare decoded events, never assume equal compressed bytes across codec implementations.
format_candidate.unknown_events_or_fields: Retain raw canonical event bytes. No fixed-enum assumption may discard a new key, arbitrary string or schema variant. A later typed/delta codec is out of initial scope until full inverse and preservation tests exist.

resource_policy_proposal.old_v1_policy_unchanged: Current producer max_events=2000000 and all frozen limits remain unmodified. No live producer is replaced in this work.
resource_policy_proposal.proposed_new_policy_requires_approval: Use a distinct versioned policy accounting actual written/temporary physical bytes and bounded inflight buffers plus the existing finite business wall-time limit, rather than simply raising the old logical-event quota.
resource_policy_proposal.not_relabeling: Do not reinterpret max_events as block count or claim a2M logical-event ceiling was satisfied after packing. Logical event totals remain explicit and can exceed2M only under a separately approved new policy.
resource_policy_proposal.budget_target: Evaluate within existing4GiB per-observer storage and original source-pair1200s budget first; no larger disk/time limit approved. Account payloads, headers, index, arrays and pending files; hardlink aliases do not duplicate physical allocation.
resource_policy_proposal.buffer_limits: Reserve before allocation/copy. Keep existing64MiB detached-array and8MiB event-metadata ceilings; explicitly budget raw/compressed block buffers and encoder worst-case expansion. No full-file read_bytes, decompression bomb or full decoded event list.
decoder_guards: Bound decoded bytes and reject unused/trailing/oversized compressed streams
Require exact contiguous first/last/count and decoded/hash match
Stream validation/comparison without accumulating millions of event dictionaries
resource_policy_proposal.fail_closed: Any disk/queue/encode/copy/close/overflow fault sets capture invalid out of business exception handling, never replans business or samples data. Physical budget/time exhaustion still stops acceptance. OS process RSS/kill and concurrent writers remain limitations.

full_capture_arrays.required_semantics: Each snapshot copied while emitted and retains logical occurrence ID, dtype/shape and content hash. Never defer hashing/compression of a live mutable view.
full_capture_arrays.initial_proposal: Retain unique array occurrence inventory; any lossless blob codec uses both decoded content hash and stored payload hash. Do not silently enable physical dedup under the old comparator.
full_capture_arrays.unknown_budget: B has hashes only; these data do not establish Full Capture array volume or compressibility. Include actual blob storage in the same finite budget, not just guard blocks.

requirements: All committed blocks contiguous from sequence0; every logical event and array occurrence accounted
No faults, orphan/missing/duplicate blocks or unresolved pending records
Both frozen operation IDs have qualification.begin and qualification.complete; expected full business receipt contains exactly U1/U2
Producer normal end, final logical digest/counts and business receipt hash bound to final completion marker
Final marker published atomically without replacement only after all files/index/footer close successfully
whole_run_completeness.saved_prefix_expected_result: Must remain incomplete:1 qualification begin,0 completes and1 open grow. Successful prefix decoding must never emit a production observer_complete marker or recover the missing tail.

comparison_and_authority.A_vs_history: Unchanged exact full business receipt comparison.
comparison_and_authority.A_vs_B: Unchanged exact full business receipt comparison.
comparison_and_authority.B_vs_C: Strict full decoded logical event and array integrity comparison, no excluded semantic/RNG/path fields. Requires a separately pinned streaming reader; existing list-loading c119 comparator is not silently reused as if it supported this format.
comparison_and_authority.authorization: Draft only. Requires separate format/resource-policy review, implementation/static noninterference and fault tests, frozen code/runtime/manifest, and fresh explicit diagnostic authorization before live use. No S07 replay now.

before_any_live_use: Byte-exact all-prefix roundtrip and independent decoder verification
Synthetic logs larger than2M logical events to exercise accounting without any pathology execution; never claim this is full S07 acceptance
Mutated/missing/duplicate/reordered block/header/index/array and every partial-close boundary rejection
No normalization/field loss for Unicode, nonfinite tags, arbitrary metadata, exceptions, dtype/endian/shape and RNG state
Producer fault isolation and unchanged business AST/ordering/RNG under off/hash/full modes
Complete-run versus truncated-prefix distinction tested independently
Independent review of bounded memory/storage/time and new immutable execution identities
